date_note: Novinky.cz (22 November) says the arrest was on Tuesday and the Interior Ministry announced it on Friday; Tuesday resolved to 17 November. The ministry page itself could not be read.
exec: Spanish police say they arrested a suspected NoName057(16) recruiter in Burgos and seized firearms; the group targets state bodies, banks and transport firms.
geo_basis: Burgos named in source as the place of arrest
impact: Arrest of one suspect; according to Spanish authorities as relayed by Novinky.cz, the group has attacked state institutions, banks and transport companies since 2024.
plain: Spanish police arrested a man in Burgos they suspect of recruiting for a pro-Russian hacker group, and found weapons at his home and a rented warehouse.

sources.name: Novinky.cz (citing the Spanish Interior Ministry and El País)

summary: Novinky.cz reports that Spain's National Police arrested a man in Burgos on Tuesday on suspicion of membership of the pro-Russian group NoName057(16) and glorifying terrorism; the Interior Ministry announced it on Friday. Searches of his flat and a rented warehouse found firearms and knives. According to Spanish authorities, the group has been behind cyberattacks since 2024 on state institutions, banks and transport companies.
title: Spanish police arrest suspected NoName057(16) recruiter in Burgos

validation.note: Only Novinky.cz read; it relays the Spanish Interior Ministry statement and El País. The ministry page (interior.gob.es) answered 403 and El País could not be fetched, so the ministry's own figures and arrest date were not checked. Novinky's count of attacks (Czech qualifier 'nejméně', at least) is left out because the figure check cannot match the Czech qualifier.

evidence.quote: Španělská policie v úterý zadržela v Burgosu v centrálním Španělsku náboráře proruské hackerské skupiny NoName057(16).
